title: feat: C_GenerateKeyPair for PIV hardware token (on-device key generation)
description: C_GenerateKeyPair is the correct in-band path when a PIV hardware token generates a key on-device: the application calls C_GenerateKeyPair, wolfP11 sends the GENERATE ASYMMETRIC KEY PAIR APDU (INS 0x47) to the token, and the key never leaves the hardware. This is the PIV-native flow and cannot be replaced by a CLI tool because the application drives it. Scope: PIV backend only (YubiKey 5, NitroKey HSM 2). Supported mechanisms: CKM_EC_KEY_PAIR_GEN (P-256, P-384) and CKM_RSA_PKCS_KEY_PAIR_GEN (2048-bit). The soft and flash backends are explicitly out of scope: those keys are provisioned out-of-band via wp11 keystore import-key (wolfP11-ctv).
